subject: URGENT: Your mailbox will be disabled today
body: We detected unusual activity on your account. Verify your identity immediately at https://example.com/account-verification and enter your email password to prevent permanent suspension. You have 30 minutes to complete this request.
expected_signals: Urgency; credential request; external URL; threat of account loss

subject: Confidential payment required before 3 PM
body: I am currently in a board meeting and cannot take calls. Process an urgent transfer of INR 4,85,000 to the new beneficiary today. Keep this confidential and reply when you are ready for the banking details.
expected_signals: Executive impersonation; urgent payment; secrecy; no independent verification

subject: Need gift cards for a client event
body: Purchase ten gift cards worth INR 5,000 each immediately. Scratch the cards and email photographs of the codes to me. Do not discuss this with the team because it is a surprise for the client.
expected_signals: Gift-card request; secrecy; financial loss; urgency

subject: Payroll correction needed immediately
body: Your salary payment was rejected. To release it today, confirm your employee ID, bank-account number, password and OTP at https://example.com/payroll-update.
expected_signals: Payroll lure; sensitive-data request; credential request; external URL

subject: Microsoft 365 session expired
body: Your Microsoft 365 session has expired and incoming messages are being held. Sign in at https://example.com/microsoft-login within one hour to release quarantined email.
expected_signals: Brand impersonation; credential lure; external URL; deletion threat

subject: CEO shared a confidential document
body: A confidential board document has been shared with you. Access expires tonight. Open https://example.com/shared-document and sign in using your corporate credentials.
expected_signals: Authority impersonation; credential request; external URL; urgency

subject: Security verification code required
body: We blocked an unauthorized login. Reply to this email with the six-digit verification code sent to your phone so the security team can close the incident.
expected_signals: OTP request; account-security pretext; urgency

subject: FINAL NOTICE: Complete KYC today
body: Your bank account will be frozen at 6 PM. Reply with copies of your PAN and Aadhaar along with your debit-card PIN and OTP to prevent suspension.
expected_signals: Identity-document request; PIN and OTP request; account threat

subject: Outstanding invoice requires review
body: The attached invoice is overdue. Download Invoice_September.zip, extract the contents and run the invoice viewer. Disable antivirus temporarily if the file is blocked.
expected_signals: Archive lure; execution instruction; antivirus-disable request; payment pressure

subject: Critical VPN certificate update
body: Remote access will stop working today unless the new certificate is installed. Download the update from https://example.com/vpn-certificate and run it as administrator.
expected_signals: Software-install request; administrator execution; external URL; urgency

subject: Package delivery failed
body: We could not deliver your package because a small fee remains unpaid. Pay INR 25 at https://example.com/redelivery to schedule another attempt.
expected_signals: Unexpected delivery; payment request; external URL

subject: You are eligible for a tax refund
body: A refund of INR 18,450 is waiting. Submit your PAN, card details and online-banking credentials at https://example.com/tax-refund before the claim expires.
expected_signals: Unexpected refund; financial-data request; credential request; external URL

subject: Mandatory benefits confirmation
body: All employees must reconfirm medical-insurance nominees today. Sign in using your corporate email and password at https://example.com/employee-benefits.
expected_signals: HR pretext; credential request; external URL; deadline

subject: Confidential legal complaint received
body: A formal complaint naming you has been submitted. Review the protected case at https://example.com/legal-case before it is escalated to management.
expected_signals: Fear tactic; confidentiality; external URL; urgency

subject: Exclusive leadership opportunity
body: Your profile has been shortlisted for a confidential leadership role with a 70 percent salary increase. Complete the application and upload your identity documents at https://example.com/executive-role.
expected_signals: Unsolicited offer; identity-document request; external URL; unusually attractive reward

subject: Files scheduled for permanent deletion
body: Your cloud storage exceeded its limit. Confirm ownership at https://example.com/storage-restore within two hours or all files will be permanently deleted.
expected_signals: Data-loss threat; external URL; urgency; login lure

subject: New protected voicemail from Finance
body: You received a protected voicemail from the Finance Director. Sign in at https://example.com/voicemail to listen before the recording expires.
expected_signals: Executive impersonation; credential lure; external URL; expiry pressure

subject: Important: new bank account for pending invoices
body: Our banking details have changed with immediate effect. Send all pending payments to the new account. Do not use the previous details or contact the former account manager.
expected_signals: Bank-detail change; payment diversion; discourages verification

subject: Scan to restore account access
body: Your account has been restricted. Scan the QR code in the attached notice or visit https://example.com/restore-access and authenticate within 45 minutes.
expected_signals: QR-code lure; external URL; credential request; urgency

subject: Employee satisfaction reward
body: Complete this short employee survey and receive a gift voucher. Sign in with your corporate account at https://example.com/employee-survey to claim the reward.
expected_signals: Reward lure; corporate credential request; external URL

subject: Project meeting tomorrow
body: Hello team, our project meeting is scheduled tomorrow at 10:00 AM. Please review the agenda in the approved project folder before joining. No account information is required.
expected_signals: Routine internal communication; no credential request; no external action

subject: Leave request approved
body: Your leave request for 21 September has been approved by your reporting manager. The approved dates are visible in the official HR portal.
expected_signals: Routine HR notification; no link; no sensitive-data request

subject: Customer review moved to Thursday
body: The customer review has been rescheduled to Thursday at 2:30 PM. The existing calendar invitation has been updated with the new time.
expected_signals: Routine calendar update; no urgency manipulation; no external link

subject: IT service request resolved
body: Service request SR-18432 regarding VPN access has been resolved. If the issue continues, reopen the ticket through the official helpdesk portal.
expected_signals: Expected service notification; references existing ticket; no credential request

subject: Monthly payslip available
body: Your monthly payslip is now available in the established HR system. Open the portal through your normal company bookmark; payroll will never request your password or OTP by email.
expected_signals: Routine payroll notice; directs user to known portal; explicitly rejects credential sharing
